# @canopy/devtools

The Canopy devtools: an in-page panel for the connection, subscriptions, store, pending mutations and protocol log, and development warnings.

Plain DOM, so it works with every framework. Keep it out of production builds.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/devtools @canopy/client
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

```ts
import { attachDevtools } from "@canopy/devtools"

if (import.meta.env.DEV) attachDevtools(canopy)
```

## Learn more

- [Devtools](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy/blob/master/apps/docs/src/content/docs/guides/devtools.md)
